scope: Focused local production-artifact regression acceptance for icon-only hamburger and richer finite motion. Runs use real browser behavior, document navigation and native downloads. No deploy or production mutation was performed by this QA task.

resolvedFindings.finding: AA signature intersected the 320px wordmark at doubled text size.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Real startup text scaling now suppresses the decorative seal where actual header boxes intersect; content and navigation remain readable.
resolvedFindings.verification: All three engines at 320px doubled text: zero horizontal overflow, seal opacity 0, no seal animation.

resolvedFindings.finding: WebKit crashed after native cross-document transition navigation from an open menu and subsequent orientation resize.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Optional native cross-document transitions removed globally; incoming content settling, menu and section motion remain.
resolvedFindings.diagnosis: Disabling only @view-transition navigation fixed the native crash. Disabling backdrop animation, canceling menu animations or waiting 700ms before click did not.
resolvedFindings.verification: All three engines complete short landscape menu navigation to Contact and immediate subsequent viewport resize in the final run.

visualReview: Inspected final desktop/mobile Home, mobile menu and 320px doubled-text screenshots. Saved real-time desktop/mobile WebM recordings preserve original motion timing.
limitations: Automated desktop browser engines and Chromium CDP touch emulation; no physical devices or OS screen reader.
Focused motion and menu regression acceptance, not a repeat of the entire Phase 4 route or Lighthouse matrix.
Visual recordings preserve actual timing. Browser animation inspection does not establish human vestibular comfort.
chromium: actual Back used a fresh document, not BFCache; persisted-event cleanup additionally exercised separately.
firefox: actual Back used a fresh document, not BFCache; persisted-event cleanup additionally exercised separately.
webkit: actual Back used a fresh document, not BFCache; persisted-event cleanup additionally exercised separately.

Actual Back traversals used fresh documents in this automation run; native BFCache eligibility/physical-device restoration is not claimed. The persisted pageshow cleanup event was separately dispatched and observed, with that distinction recorded in each scenario.
Doubled-text startup uses an HTTP-response-only test script to set actual computed font-size and line-height to 2x before deferred application modules initialize. This is not browser-native zoom.
The main local matrix precedes the final Home navigation aria-current fallback marker change; the root release owner performs final artifact and hosted smoke checks separately.
Performance is measured separately after closing these browser contexts; this report makes no Lighthouse or field Web Vitals claim.
